svg.title: Notification count changes, announced — SoftTrack web design mockup (#77)
svg.desc: The bell already has an accessible name with the count. What is missing is an announcement when the count changes: a visually hidden aria-live="polite" region says the new count, on change only, and says nothing when it drops to zero.
svg.text: · no new components and no styling changes: a polite live region
Five polls of the unread count, and what a screen reader hears
the bell looks exactly as it does today

g.text: Same count on the next poll: silence.
The badge says 9+; speech says the real
Read them all: zero announces nothing
A poll that brings the same number says nothing; the region text is
It waits for the reader to finish; no toast, nothing visible.
The same words as the button,
from the notifications catalog (bell.labelUnread), pluralised by count.

svg.text: Good first issue, and smaller than it looks: the accessible name with the count (“Notifications (3 unread)”) already ships in NotificationsBell.tsx, with the badge aria-hidden. The
remaining work is the polite live region fed by useUnreadCount, plus a test that a repeated count and a drop to zero say nothing.
